maintenance.tunnelBusy: Please wait: connecting or disconnecting has not finished yet.
maintenance.snapshotsFailed: Could not create the snapshots folder.

capture.unavailable: Packet capture is not available in this version of the app.

protection.failed: The protection could not be applied.
protection.unreadable: The protection filters could not be read.

repair.disconnectFirst: Disconnect the VPN first: the repair runs only without an active connection.
repair.strictKept: Strict mode: the persistent filters were kept. To remove them, turn strict mode off in Settings.
repair.legacyDeferred: The old version is still running: close it and repeat the repair.
repair.checkRunning: A server check is running: no processes were stopped, repeat after it finishes.

selfTest.needsSession: The protection test works only with an active connection.

route.softMode: Soft mode: the routing test applies to TUN mode only. Programs that do not use the system proxy go direct.

legacy.retryUnavailable: Re-importing the keys is not available in this version of the app: they stay in the old version's files.
legacy.importPending: The old version's data has not been fully imported yet: restart the app and try again.
legacy.keysPending: Move the keys from the old version first: otherwise they are lost with the folder.
legacy.notOldData: This folder does not look like the old version's data and will not be deleted.
legacy.inUse: The old version's files are in use: close the old version of the app and try again.
legacy.denied: Access to some of the old version's files was denied.
legacy.deleteFailed: Some of the old version's files could not be deleted.
